% A footnote in an example, and one in a line of prose a user might select
% to typeset: tools/run_onlyoffice_test.mjs opens the converted .docx and
% holds the plugin to refusing both, since the typed lines have no place
% for a note and going ahead would delete it.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{linguexx}
\begin{document}

Jean dort bien.\footnote{A note in the prose.}

\ex. \gll Jean dort\footnote{A note in the gloss.} bien \\
     John sleeps well \\
     \glt `John sleeps well.'

\ex. \gll Marie chante \\
     Mary sings \\
     \glt `Mary sings.'

\end{document}
